title: Fractal Firebending
description: Adds firebending to the game! Comet Incoming!
body:
Unleash the power of fire with aggressive abilities focused on damage, mobility, and sustained pressure.

10+
Abilities Like:

Fire Blast — Quick projectile fire blast on punch
Flame Sweep — Close-range flame arc that damages and ignites enemies
Firekick — Dash forward with a fiery kick on punch, or hold shift for a spinning fire attack that drains chi over time
Fire Streams — Hold shift to stream continuous fire at your target
Combustion — Shift-punch for an instant explosive blast (no charging required)
Fire Shield — Hold shift to create a defensive flame barrier that heals you
Fire Breath — Hold shift to breathe fire, cool nearby lava, and regenerate chi (+2/sec) with minor healing
Dragon Breath - High power AOE damage and water buster!
Fire Jets - Flight with Fire
Fire benders receive bonus chi regeneration when near torches, campfires, or lanterns.

/b choose
Requires Fractal Bending Core.
